Class ExpressionPanelButtons

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.logicprogrammer.client.ExpressionPanelButtons
public class ExpressionPanelButtons extends Object
The buttons of the expression panel: Undo, Redo, Format and Copy right of the title, and the button to add a parameter after the chips.

    • ExpressionPanelButtons

      public ExpressionPanelButtons(BooleanSupplier firstParameter, Runnable addParameter, Runnable undo, Runnable redo, Runnable format, Runnable copy)
      Parameters:
      firstParameter - If adding a parameter adds the first one, so the button says what it adds, as there are no chips next to it.
      addParameter - Adds a parameter.
      undo - Goes back one change.
      redo - Goes forward one change.
      format - Prints the expression in its canonical form.
      copy - Copies the text.
